title: Desktop input method port
what: The Rust port reading fcitx5's trigger keys, Hangul layout and state from its configuration files and the session bus, in src/desktop/input_method.rs, carried beside the sidecar.

title: Desktop pointer decoding port
what: The Rust port that turns RDP pointer updates into cursor shapes and messages with RGBA pixels for the page, in src/desktop/pointers.rs, carried beside the sidecar.

title: Desktop relay protocol port
what: The Rust port of the relay's RDP protocol reading: RDCleanPath, negotiation, CredSSP with NTLM, framing, redirection, the logon packet and quality flags, in the protocol modules of src/desktop/, carried beside the sidecar the service runs instead.

title: Desktop sidecar process
what: The service's start and restart of the bun desktop sidecar, the environment it hands it, and the three browser sockets carried to it frame for frame, in src/desktop/sidecar.rs.
